caption: The drawing depicts a full suit consisting of a long coat, waistcoat, and breeches, all in a light brown or tan color. The coat features large buttons down the front and on the cuffs, and its cuffs are decorated with white lace that extends outward. A white lace jabot or cravat is depicted at the neck, flowing down the chest in intricate folds. The waistcoat beneath is also brown, visible through the opening of the coat, and fastens with closely spaced buttons. The breeches match the coat and waistcoat in color and feature buttons at the knee area. The suit is illustrated with careful attention to detail, showing the texture and folds of the fabric, with shading suggesting volume. On the upper right corner, there is a black ink outline of the coat seen from the back, showing seams, the back style, and button placement for a reference view. The background is a plain, light-colored surface.
title: Man's Costume
